entry.name: value
entry.digest: Share data between other value objects
entry.description: Shares data with other value objects of the same name. If you send a message (number, list, or anything else) to one value object, it is set for all value objects with the same 'name' argument. You can get the contents out of a particular value object by sending it a bang.

arguments.name: name
arguments.description: Sets the name of theobject. Otherobjects with the same name will share it's contents.

arguments.name: initial
arguments.description: Additional arguments after the naming symbol initialize the contents of. If no additional arguments are present,contains nothing.
